TaskDescription: Spontaneous seizure trace released by the authors to plot manuscript figures (file plot_sz_238.pkl).

stim-seizures-manuscript preprocessing.Description: Preprocessed by the authors (bipolar montage, resampled to 128 Hz; see code/seizure_preprocessing_sandbox.ipynb and stim_seizure_preprocessing_utils.py in github.com/penn-cnt/stim-seizures-manuscript). Exact filter settings are not stated in the deposit.

iEEGReference: bipolar: each channel is the difference of two adjacent contacts on the same lead (names 'A-B')
Description: Values copied from the released pandas pickle (float64) to IEEE float32. Sampling rate 128 Hz is the value used by the authors' plotting notebook (fs = 128); amplitude units are not stated in the source (channels.tsv units n/a). Time zero is the first sample of the released trace, not the recording start.
